video_title: Exclusive: KEVON LOONEY ON LUKA’S LEADERSHIP 👀🔥 | New Lakers Veteran - Mason & Ireland

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on the importance of team chemistry and bonding
quotes.excerpt: Chemistry is big in our sport and the best teams that win usually have great chemistry.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: I heard Zaire in a recent interview talk about how that trip, you guys really bonded and that he thought that that bonding would actually translate onto the court. Do you agree and why?

text_blocks.speaker: Kevon Looney
text_blocks.text: For sure. Usually you don't get to see guys until training camp really starts and it's a feeling out process trying to learn guys, learn guys' personalities. So when you are able to come together in the summertime and really bond, especially when you are going on an 11 and a half hour flight, you really get to know each other. You get to see guys outside of the basketball court how they act, how they like to move around and chemistry is big in our sport and the best teams that win usually have great chemistry, so it was a great building block for us.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney's outlook on the new Lakers team's potential
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we have a great chance. We have a lot of talent.

text_blocks.speaker: Andy Kamenetzky
text_blocks.text: Do you have any idea what this looks like when you actually get out there? It's a brand new team.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevon Looney
text_blocks.text: A couple weeks ago I would have said no, but after going on that trip and spending time with Luka and getting to know the guys and playing pickup, playing five-on-five and really getting to appreciate myself with all the team, I feel like we have a great chance. We have a lot of talent. We have high-end talent like Luka and AR. You always have a shot and we have I think great role players and guys that spin around, got a chip on their shoulder that want to improve themselves. I think we got a shot.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on Luka's leadership and character
quotes.excerpt: That just shows his character, showing that he really wants to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Andy Kamenetzky
text_blocks.text: What have you noticed about Luka as a leader in terms of getting you guys together on the same page?

text_blocks.speaker: Kevon Looney
text_blocks.text: I've been in the league for a while and that was my first time doing something like that, to go into somebody's country and bring us all out there and spend that much time together. That's I never did that before. So that just shows his character, showing that he really wants to win, he wants people to know his background, why he is how he is and I think we did a good job of that. He's a great player and a great leader and he likes to show what he can do on the court and we got to see his personality off the court, so it was great.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on his role as a veteran leader
quotes.excerpt: As a role player, you kind of just find your voice and just trying to be able to relate to everybody on the court.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Mason
text_blocks.text: From that perspective, how do you plan on using that voice when you're with a guy like Luka and someone like Austin?

text_blocks.speaker: Kevon Looney
text_blocks.text: I've played with a lot of teams with a lot of great players and as a role player, you kind of just find your voice and just trying to be able to relate to everybody on the court. I've played in a lot of different roles on a lot of different teams. I've started, I've came off the bench, I've been a guy that didn't play that much, I've been a guy that played in close games, so I kind of know how every player feels from that viewpoint. So I try to relate to them and go tell them my experience and I won a few championships so I know what it takes to get there.
